Meta Ads Campaign Structure

Instagram Post Engagement Campaign

Engagement objective | $15/day | Canada | Facebook and Instagram feeds only

1. Campaign at a glance

Setting

Value

Objective

Engagement

Conversion location

On your ad

Performance goal

Maximize engagement with a post (post engagement)

Budget

$15.00 per day, set at ad set level

Location

Canada

1 campaign, 1 ad set, 2 ads

2. Structure

Level

Name

Purpose

Campaign

IG_Engagement_PostEng_CA_[Month]

Sets the Engagement objective

Ad set

CA_21-60_FeedsOnly_PostEng

Ad 1

Ad01_ExistingPost_Carousel_[Topic]

Best recent carousel post

Ad 2

Ad02_ExistingPost_Reel_[Topic]

Why one ad set: $15/day is too small to split. One ad set lets Meta move spend to the post that earns the most interactions.
